# libvpx (vendored)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Project | libvpx, the WebM project's VP8 and VP9 codec library (decoders only) |
| Upstream | <https://chromium.googlesource.com/webm/libvpx>, <https://github.com/webmproject/libvpx> |
| Tag | `v1.17.0` |
| Commit | `6df3ec34557879fff673706f4a1d9fbd0f3a6f0e` |
| Archive | <https://github.com/webmproject/libvpx/archive/refs/tags/v1.17.0.tar.gz>, SHA-256 `1020f184046187baa2985dbde38e0691f49c44088bca7a1842b0236c6081dc0a` (5,670,546 bytes; GitHub generates it, so the hash is ours) |
| License | BSD-3-Clause (`LICENSE`) with the WebM project's patent grant (`PATENTS`), both copied verbatim, with `AUTHORS` |
| Files | The C sources libvpx's own makefiles (`vpx/vpx_codec.mk`, `vpx_mem/`, `vpx_scale/`, `vpx_ports/`, `vpx_dsp/`, `vpx_util/`, `vp8/vp8_common.mk`, `vp8/vp8dx.mk`, `vp9/vp9_common.mk`, `vp9/vp9dx.mk`) select for the configuration below, and the headers they include, except the architecture-specific ones behind `VPX_ARCH_*`/`HAVE_*` (0 here), byte-identical to the archive above (`.gitattributes` keeps them out of end-of-line conversion) |
| Modifications | none |

Use: VP8 and VP9 decoding for `src/alchemy/darwin/media/media_codecs.cpp`, built by `cmake/darwin/media_codecs.cmake` as the static library `alchemy_vpx`.

## Configuration (`config/`, generated, not upstream files)

Equivalent to `configure --target=generic-gnu --disable-encoders --enable-vp9-highbitdepth --disable-multithread`: VP8 and VP9 decoders, generic C (no assembly, intrinsics or run-time CPU detection), high bit depth, single-threaded, spatial resampling on, post-processing and error concealment off. `config/sources.txt` is the list of C sources the makefiles select for it; `vpx_config.h` defines every `CONFIG_*`, `HAVE_*` and `VPX_ARCH_*` the vendored sources and the rtcd definitions test; `vpx_config.c` and `vpx_version.h` are what the build writes for v1.17.0; the four `*_rtcd.h` are the output of the upstream `build/make/rtcd.pl --arch=generic` (not vendored) on `vp8/common/rtcd_defs.pl`, `vp9/common/vp9_rtcd_defs.pl`, `vpx_dsp/vpx_dsp_rtcd_defs.pl` and `vpx_scale/vpx_scale_rtcd.pl` of the same tag.

## Test vectors (`test-vectors/`)

From the libvpx test suite's data store, <https://storage.googleapis.com/downloads.webmproject.org/test_data/libvpx/>, each checked against the SHA-1 in the tag's `test/test-data.sha1`: `vp80-00-comprehensive-001.ivf`, `vp90-2-02-size-08x08.webm`, `vp91-2-04-yuv444.webm`, `vp92-2-20-10bit-yuv420.webm`, and their `.md5` per-frame checksums. Used by `alchemy_gui_media_codecs` only.

To update: download the new release from the upstream above, check its published hash, copy the same set of files with the vendoring rules above, and update this file, the hashes and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
